nodes.label: REST API
nodes.description: API style using REST architecture with resources represented as nouns and standard HTTP methods.

nodes.label: Paginated API
nodes.description: Large lists use pagination with page, limit, and total fields in response.

nodes.label: API Versioning
nodes.description: All APIs prefixed with /api/v1/ for versioning support.

nodes.label: API Guidelines
nodes.description: API design standards, endpoint structures, response formats, validation rules, and communication patterns.

nodes.label: No Direct Database Access
nodes.description: API endpoints must never directly access database; must go through Repository layer.

nodes.label: Consistent Response Format
nodes.description: All responses follow {success, message, data} format; errors follow {success, message, error_code}.
